transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's this cough, mainly. It just won't go away.
When did you first notice the cough?
Hard to say exactly — it came on a while back, after I had a cold.
Have you ever had any allergies, or a bad reaction to a medicine?
No, not that I know of. I've never had a bad reaction to anything.
How much does the cough affect your daily activities?
It bothers me a fair bit, but I get by. It's mainly at night that it's troublesome.
Are you taking any medicines at the moment?
Yes, a few — some inhalers and a tablet for my blood pressure.
How much is the cough bothering you overall — a little, moderately, or a lot, or are you not sure?
Quite a lot, I'd say. It's waking me up most nights — I'd put it at about a 6 out of 10.
Have you noticed any other symptoms along with the cough?
I get a bit more out of breath than usual when I walk to the shop. No blood or anything like that, and no chest pain.
When you cough, where in your body do you feel it most, and does it stay in that one spot or spread anywhere else?
It's just in my chest, really. It doesn't spread anywhere else.
Is there anything that seems to make your cough better or worse?
Cold air sets it off, and talking for a long time. Steam helps a little.
Besides your blood pressure, is there anything else about your health from the past that you think I should know about?
I've got COPD — had it about eight years now. And I used to smoke, but I gave that up about ten years ago.
What worries you most about this cough?
I suppose I'm worried my lungs are getting worse. Or that it could be something more serious, like cancer.
What does your cough feel like when it happens?
I bring up some phlegm with it — more than the bit I usually get in the mornings.
Is there anything else about your past health that you think I should know?
No, that's about it as far as I know.
Besides the cough, the extra phlegm and getting more out of breath, is there anything else you've noticed that seems new or different?
No, nothing new. No blood, no weight loss, no night sweats, no chest pain.
Did this cough come on suddenly one day, or did it build up gradually over time, or are you not sure?
It came on gradually, I think — it started about three weeks ago, after I had a cold.
Have you been taking any medicines regularly, started or changed any recently, or are you not sure?
I've a blue inhaler — salbutamol — for when I get wheezy, and a Fostair one, twice a day. And lisinopril for the blood pressure. Nothing new, though I'm using the blue one more than I normally do.
Thanks — that's helpful. Is there anything else about your medicines you'd like to mention, like anything you buy over the counter or anything you've stopped taking lately?
No, I don't take anything else. Just those.
Is there anything else you've noticed that's been different or bothering you lately, along with the cough?
No, I don't think so. Just the cough and being a bit more puffed than usual.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
